messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: RStan and RStanARM Summer Workshops
parts:
One or more of us will be presenting Stan (via its R interfaces) at several conferences this summer:

Open Data Science Conference Boston May 20 -- 22
useR Stanford June 27
International Meeting of the Psychometric Society Asheville, NC July 11
Joint Statistical Meetings Chicago July 30
Applied and Agricultural Economics Association Boston August 1 -- 3

The content and format may differ from conference to conference, but the basic outline will be similar to the proposal we submitted for useR, which is attached. The early registration deadlines for the first two conferences are in the next week or two, so be sure to register soon if you are interested. The exact dates for the Stan workshops at Open Data Science and the Applied and Agricultural Economics Association have not yet been determined.

Ben

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] RStan and RStanARM Summer Workshops
parts:
Bill Gillespie's doing a tutorial on Stan and PK/PD
at AcOP in October. I can recommend it having talked
to Bill and seen the course notes---he's also had a
fair bit of practice doing these.

And Sebastian Weber's doing an online webinar.

Or if you have a suggestion for how to raise an audience
and handle local logistics, we're all ears. At
the point we can rustle up 20--30 paying customers,
we'll travel to just about anywhere.

Daniel, Michael, and I will all be back in NY
around November, so we might think about doing something
November or December in NYC, but don't have plans yet.

- Bob
